what_does_it_do: It defines how to provide human-readable distinguishing information for NMOS Assets - Nodes and Devices.
why_does_it_matter: Inconsistent naming approaches across vendors and products can complicate configuration and operation.
how_does_it_work: It defines tags for fixed information about Nodes and Devices.
These include Manufacturer, Product Name, Instance Identifier, and (for Devices only) Function.
